drug_authority.value: Physicians may prescribe, administer, and dispense drugs including controlled substances. Telemedicine prescribing of opioids is limited to FDA-approved medication assisted treatment for opioid use disorder or patients in hospital/long-term care. Prescribers of controlled substances must register with and comply with the North Dakota prescription drug monitoring program.
drug_authority.quote: A licensee who has performed a telemedicine examination or evaluation meeting the requirements of this chapter may prescribe medications according to the licensee's professional discretion and judgment. Opioids may only be prescribed through telemedicine if prescribed as a federal food and drug administration approved medication assisted treatment for opioid use disorder or to a patient in a hospital or long-term care facility.

license_status_types.quote: Issue a conditional, restricted, or otherwise circumscribed license as it determines necessary.

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: International medical school graduates must: (1) possess degree of doctor of medicine or board-approved equivalent; (2) complete 24 months of postgraduate training in a US/Canadian accredited program (or at least 12 months if equivalent experience found); (3) present ECFMG certificate; (4) demonstrate working ability in English. Osteopathic graduates from outside the US are not eligible.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: An applicant who has graduated from a medical school not located in the United States, its possessions, territories, or Canada, must present evidence, satisfactory to the board, that the applicant has successfully completed twentyfour months of postgraduate training in a program located in the United States, its possessions, territories, or Canada, and accredited by a national accrediting organization approved by the board

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: An applicant who is a graduate of an approved medical or osteopathic school located in the United States, its possessions, territories, or Canada, must present evidence, satisfactory to the board, that the applicant has successfully completed one year of postgraduate training in the United States or Canada in a program approved by the board or by an accrediting body approved by the board.

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: Opioids may only be prescribed through telemedicine if prescribed as FDA-approved medication assisted treatment for opioid use disorder or to a patient in a hospital or long-term care facility; opioids may not be prescribed through telemedicine for any other purpose.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: Opioids may only be prescribed through telemedicine if prescribed as a federal food and drug administration approved medication assisted treatment for opioid use disorder or to a patient in a hospital or long-term care facility. Opioids may not be prescribed through a telemedicine encounter for any other purpose.

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: a licensee who, pursuant to this chapter, prescribes a controlled substance, as defined by North Dakota law, shall comply with all state and federal laws regarding the prescribing of a controlled substance, and shall participate in the North Dakota prescription drug monitoring program.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: A licensee who has performed a telemedicine examination or evaluation meeting statutory requirements may prescribe medications according to professional discretion and judgment. Opioids may only be prescribed via telemedicine for FDA-approved medication-assisted treatment for opioid use disorder, or for patients in hospital or long-term care facilities. Controlled substance prescribers must participate in the ND prescription drug monitoring program.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: A licensee who has performed a telemedicine examination or evaluation meeting the requirements of this chapter may prescribe medications according to the licensee's professional discretion and judgment. Opioids may only be prescribed through telemedicine if prescribed as a federal food and drug administration approved medication assisted treatment for opioid use disorder or to a patient in a hospital or long-term care facility.

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: A physician assistant may prescribe, dispense, administer, and procure drugs and medical devices; may prescribe and dispense schedule II through V substances and all legend drugs; may not dispense a drug unless pharmacy services are not reasonably available, dispensing is in the best interest of the patient, or an emergency exists; must register with DEA and comply with state and federal laws if prescribing controlled substances.

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: A licensee shall report the following to the board within thirty days: ... b. A malpractice judgment or settlement made on behalf of an individual licensee.

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: A medical licensee or any institution from which the medical licensee voluntarily resigns or voluntarily limits the licensee's staff privileges shall report that licensee's action to the investigative panel of the board if that action occurs while the licensee is under formal or informal investigation by the institution or a committee of the institution for any reason related to possible medical incompetence, unprofessional conduct, or mental or physical impairment within thirty days.
